excluded_outputs.other_variables: Scored in the separate HRES weather-field panel; no cross-unit average

date_selection: First deterministic case of each quarter, in 2021; four-date development smoke, separate from 2022 evaluation
pooling: Non-overlapping area-weighted blocks of 1,4,16 native cells; partial polar block retained; task-owned diagnostic, not exact paper pooling
split_rationale: Training through 2020; public development smoke in 2021; separate 2022 evaluation
truth_missingness: Preserve sparse source NaNs as a fixed truth-only mask, require at least 99.99% valid spherical area in every field/level/case/lead, and require all predictions finite. The same mask is applied to every model and before spatial pooling; no dates are selected using model errors.
truth_semantics: ERA5 accumulation during (valid_time - 6 hours, valid_time]; output-only variable, following FGN appendix A.1.2. Do not use zero HRES-fc0 precipitation as truth.
